superseded_runs.reason: Old CO fixture assumed Fmax zero; JSON process count still 1504. Corrected test integration, application code unchanged.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: Application inputs match the successful matrix commit. Eight local user extensions are retained.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.
Fmax readback is restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 and SMU 115.46.0. It reports a stored ceiling, not operating clocks. A7/A8 power-adjustment units remain unverified.

Per-core/CCD storage boundaries are verified against MP5 copy instructions. Field labels, units, active masks, physical mapping, and dual-rail voltage consumption/readback remain unverified; runtime 61h stays denied.
AMD PStates writes, other AMD platforms and Curve Shaper, remaining Intel server/board controls, dynamic memory/EC and broader native PM transport remain incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

visual_review.method: Opened all four original PNG files with view_image
findings: Read Fmax and Apply Fmax controls are visible on EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04.
Success fixtures show requested 5000 MHz, readback 5000 MHz, Matches request Yes and operating frequency Not measured.
Mismatch fixtures retain requested 5000 MHz, readback 6000 MHz, Matches request No / not verified. A subsequent blocked apply changes the status to Read Fmax first.
No overlapping controls or missing result rows observed at the captured 1400x1250 size. Other display sizes were not manually reviewed.

limits: Stored ceiling is not a measured frequency. Firmware clamping and concurrent writers can produce a mismatch.
REA analyses the original UEFI modules; Ghidra with the isolated decoder extension analyses Xtensa bodies.
Approximate FP operations and conversions stay opaque in decompilation; finite replay does not execute firmware.
Per-core/CCD labels, units, active masks, physical mapping and second rail consumption/readback remain unresolved; runtime 61h stays denied.
FP update-store variant remains unresolved. Fmax replay compares both interpretations; shared ceiling and response agree, policy-array addresses differ. PM numerical normalization remains unverified.

fp_update_variant_conflict.evidence_method: Local source-hash and raw-byte comparison; firmware ISA variant unresolved.
fp_update_variant_conflict.qemu_operation: SSIP uses the old base for the memory store, then increments the base by the immediate; translate_ldsti_s parameters {true,false,true}.
fp_update_variant_conflict.stock_operation: SSIU increments the base before the memory store.
fp_update_variant_conflict.structural_inference: Post-increment is consistent with independent per-word normalization in the 157-iteration MP5 loop; this does not independently establish the configured ISA.

fmax_variant_comparison.limitation: Both address interpretations are tested; downstream policy helper and MP5 effects remain unmodeled.
